'''Beyorth Gommdora''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[sentientologist]] with the [[University of Huvveck]]. He conducted research on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Joralla]], including on the extinct [[Wasilsi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. He advanced a theory that the Wasilsi were not native to Jorella, but either established a colony on the planet or otherwise crashed there, and were subsequently wiped out by a plague. His research was harried by violent encounters with [[Tikiarri]] tribes.
